title: Setup flow illustrations and microcopy for Optimize onboarding (quant/caching recommendations)
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design a lightweight first-run setup experience and companion visuals that guide engineers through Optimize toolkit recommendations (batching profiles, prefix/KV cache suggestions, and quantization tradeoffs). Deliver a set of screens and annotated assets ready for engineering handoff and marketing screenshots. Emphasize clear microcopy for defaults, a compact explainer for accuracy vs cost (quantization), and a live-preview card showing expected latency/cost delta for chosen settings.
acceptance_criteria: Five annotated Figma screens: welcome, workload selector, batching & cache suggestion, quantization recommendation, confirmation/preview
Microcopy vetted by PM and Eng: default tooltip text <= 160 characters per tooltip
Two A/B copy variants for the quant recommendation step (conservative vs aggressive) prepared
Exported production screenshots at 1440x900 and 1280x720 with content flagged for localization
Accessibility check: color contrast >= 4.5:1 for all interactive text, keyboard focus states documented
Handoff package uploaded to Drive with tokens for copy and an engineering-spec doc (simple table)
tasks: Create low-fidelity wireframes for the 5 screens
Design high-fidelity UI in Figma using Redwood visual system
Write microcopy for each tooltip, CTA, and confirmation modal
Design the live-preview delta card (tokens, estimated latency, estimated cost)
Prepare exportable screenshots and annotate elements that must be dynamic
Run internal copy review with PM and ML Eng and incorporate feedback
Perform color-contrast and keyboard navigation checks
Bundle handoff (Figma links, PNGs, copy CSV) and upload to Drive
design_notes: Main UX goal is to reduce time-to-first-good-config. Provide a simple workload picker (low-throughput chat, medium-throughput API, high-throughput embeddings) that pre-populates batching/cache suggestions. Quantization step must include a concise risk note: 'Up to X% throughput improvement; small risk of degraded rare-token fidelity.' Include inline 'Learn more' link to docs. Prefer single-column modal for step flow to simplify mobile screenshots.
tradeoffs_and_decisions: Chose conservative quant copy for default to reduce support incidents; aggressive variant available via A/B
Removed multi-select for custom batch sizes to keep initial flow under 3 minutes
Decided to show estimated cost delta as percentage plus absolute tokens/hour to make impact tangible
Deferred advanced tuning link to post-onboarding in-console Optimize page to shorten handoff scope
review_feedback: 2026-02-22 - PM Nora Patel: Favor clearer CTA text; replace 'Apply recommended settings' with 'Use recommended configuration'
2026-02-25 - Eng lead Mateo Alvarez: Live-preview numbers should use 95th percentile latency for conservative estimate; changed metric source to 'runtime-1.20 profiling data'
2026-03-02 - Accessibility review (Jules Park): Increase color contrast on low-priority badges; added focus outline to suggested toggles
2026-03-08 - Legal/Security (R. Singh): Add privacy blurb for on-device keying in private deployments; minor wording added to confirmation screen
localization_notes: Text strings exported in CSV. Keep all CTA copy under 28 characters where possible. Reserve space for languages with longer text; confirmation modal should allow +40% vertical expansion.
qa_checklist: Verify screenshots render correctly at both target resolutions
Confirm tooltip copy matches exported CSV
Check keyboard navigation order for the 5 screens
Validate live-preview numbers match Eng-provided mock API
Ensure all 'Learn more' links open docs in new tab
final_status_notes: Design assets uploaded and PR opened. Awaiting Eng implementation of live-preview API and final PM copy approval. Prepare for A/B experiment tagging in telemetry after launch.
